name: EnhanceWizard
tagline: Free AI image enhancer: upscale, unblur and sharpen photos online.
description:
EnhanceWizard is an AI photo enhancer that upscales, unblurs and sharpens images right in the browser. The free Standard tier works up to 1024px with no watermark and no sign-up card; HD output is available with credits.

Free AI image enhancer: upscale, unblur and sharpen photos online. EnhanceWizard is built for anyone who has a photo that is too small, too soft or slightly out of focus and wants a better version without installing software or learning a complicated editor.

What it does: upload an image and EnhanceWizard uses AI to upscale it to a larger size, reduce blur and sharpen fine detail. Everything happens online in your browser, so there is nothing to download and no desktop app to set up.

Who it is for: anyone who works with photos, such as people tidying up personal pictures, sellers preparing product shots, bloggers and designers who need a cleaner image, and anyone searching for an image upscaler, a photo enhancer or a way to unblur an image.

Pricing: EnhanceWizard is freemium. The free Standard tier enhances images up to 1024px, adds no watermark and does not ask for a credit card at sign-up. If you need higher resolution results, HD output is available with credits, so you only pay when you want more.

Use cases: upscale a small image, unblur a shaky photo, sharpen a soft picture, and improve photos before sharing or publishing them online.

Try the free Standard tier at enhancewizard.com.
